## Description {#details}

<p>Helper template for registering a target object file info implementation.</p>


<p>This invokes the static "Create" method on the class to actually do the construction. Usage:</p>


<p>extern "C" void LLVMInitializeFooTarget() { extern <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/target">Target</a> TheFooTarget; RegisterMCObjectFileInfo&lt;FooMCObjectFileInfo&gt; <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/tablegen/tablegenbackendskeleton-cpp/#ab60f28d7a141ac46ccc200176a1bca8b">X(TheFooTarget)</a>; }</p>


<p>Definition at line 1084 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/mc/targetregistry-h">TargetRegistry.h</a>.</p>
